title: Telepathic contact with the orb 'Sylvia'
place_text: Baker Victory Services, Western New York

tellings.quote: fractalizing type energy. And in one of the experiences, it was telling me that his name was Sylvia.

plain: Around 2008 to 2010, at Baker Victory Services, a children's care facility in Western New York, a glowing orb of what he calls "fractalizing type energy" spoke to a boy named Jordan Jose by thought and told him its name was Sylvia. Jose, who says he was taken into a secret UFO programme as a child, tells Jesse Michels this from his own experience and mentions a woman named Meg in connection with it.
